snippet.title: Plant a Tree! 🌳 Every Bite Is a Good Deed | Islam for Kids #shorts
snippet.description:
Look! I have a tiny seed. What will it become?

Our Prophet Muhammad-e-Mustafa (Sallallahu Ta'ala Alaihi Wa Aalihi Wasallam) taught us: when a Muslim plants a tree, and a bird, a person or an animal eats from it, it counts as a charity (sadaqah) for him!

So let's plant! Dig a little hole, drop in the seed, cover it up, and water it every day. When it grows into a big apple tree, every bird and every hungry animal that eats from it is a good deed for the one who planted it. What can you plant this week? Ask your grown-up!

Source
• Sahih al-Bukhari 2320 (narrated by Hazrat Anas bin Malik, Radi Allahu Anhu): https://sunnah.com/bukhari:2320

Masjid-e-Nabawi footage: DesignwithRiyas on Pixabay (https://pixabay.com/videos/id-112361/)

We never show any Prophet or Companion. Only an ordinary family is drawn.
For ages 3 to 9 · Ahl-e-Sunnat wal Jama'at
